name: singlet_enrichment_pathway_resource_curation
title: Curated pathway resource construction and recovery
description: Builds one harmonised signed pathway resource from PROGENy, Hallmark or OmniPath sources, filters sets by size and overlap, and optionally ranks resources by recovery of held-out perturbations. Needs gene symbols matching the organism and, for recovery, a normalised layer with source and study labels. Writes the resource table, set statistics and provenance, never cell scores. Use singlet_enrichment_pathway_footprint_activity to score cells or samples, and singlet_enrichment_over_representation_analysis to test a gene list.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

name.description: Resource name under uns/pathway_resource; defaults to the source names joined by plus signs.

organism.description: Organism of the resource and data; mouse maps by orthology.

sources.description: Resources to combine; hallmark and omnipath read snapshots from uns/pathway_sources.

context_label.description: Optional obs column naming the cell-type or tissue context; recorded per row and used to stratify recovery.

curation.description: Size and overlap filters applied before the table is written.

min_set_size.description: Smallest allowed set; 10 is the lower bound of the usual 10 to 15 range.

max_set_size.description: Largest allowed set, so that broad generic sets cannot dominate.

overlap_measure.description: Overlap measure for pruning; overlap_coefficient also flags small sets nested in large ones.

overlap_threshold.description: Prune the smaller of two sets above this overlap; null disables pruning.

progeny.description: PROGENy footprint options; defaults reproduce the R net.

top_per_pathway.description: Genes kept per pathway by model p-value; null keeps all genes when padj_threshold is also null.

padj_threshold.description: Adjusted p-value cut applied before the top-N step; null disables it.

license.description: Subset class; the default retrieves all interactions, so set commercial or nonprofit for restricted use.

recovery.description: Optional recovery scoring of each resource on a perturbation compendium; omit to skip.

source_key.description: obs column giving the perturbed source of each sample or cell; required when recovery is requested.

study_key.description: obs column giving the study label used for leave-study-out splits.

statistic.description: Statistic applied to every resource in the call; ulm is the default.

layer.description: Normalised expression layer; raw counts are rejected.

seed.description: Permutation seed, used only by the gsea statistic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing resource members of the same name instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/pathway_resource/<name>/table. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: sources, sets_total, sets_retained, mean_pairwise_jaccard, statistic (when recovery ran).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
